decisions.decision: Workers edit query.sql only. The LEADER runs make sqlc once, after both tiers' SQL edits land.
decisions.why: One sqlc.yaml regenerates all four modules, so two parallel workers running codegen would race on each other's generated files.

decisions.decision: Accepted the worker's refusal to poke session_id in the schema self-check.
decisions.why: session_id is the ON CONFLICT match key. Poking it sends the upsert down the INSERT path, so the test would prove nothing. Matches charging's sibling exemption.

decisions.decision: writtenColumns/denyListColumns stay hardcoded in the test; only the LIVE column list is derived from information_schema.
decisions.why: tasks.md asked to derive both; design.md D7.7 only requires the live list. Parsing query.sql at run time is fragile. design.md wins and matches the charging precedent.
